import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if not exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Text column and label columns
text_col = "comment_text"
label_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Separate train validation
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(train.index, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
train_data = train.loc[train_idx]
val_data = train.loc[val_idx]

# TF-IDF vectorization
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2)
X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_data[text_col])
X_val = vectorizer.transform(val_data[text_col])
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test[text_col])

y_train = train_data[label_cols].values
y_val = val_data[label_cols].values

# LightGBM models for each label
import lightgbm as lgb

lgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

auc_scores = []
models = []

for col in label_cols:
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**lgb_params)
    # FIX: Use the column directly instead of boolean mask
    model.fit(X_train, y_train[:, col].astype(int))
    val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    try:
        # FIX: Use the column directly for validation score
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, col], val_pred)
        auc_scores.append(auc)
        models.append(model)
    except:
        auc_scores.append(0.5)

avg_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"Validation Column-wise ROC AUC: {avg_auc:.6f}")

# Retrain on full training data for submission
# Note: We only train on train_data, not combined train+validation
full_X_train = vectorizer.transform(train_data[text_col])
full_y_train = train_data[label_cols].values

final_models = []
for col in label_cols:
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**lgb_params, verbose=-1)
    model.fit(full_X_train, full_y_train[:, col].astype(int))
    final_models.append(model)

# Predict on test data
sub = sample_submission.copy()
for i, col in enumerate(label_cols):
    pred = final_models[i].predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    sub[col] = pred

# Save submission
sub.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

# Verify submission format
print(f"Submission shape: {sub.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {list(sub.columns)}")

print(f"\nColumn-wise ROC AUC on hold-out validation set: {avg_auc:.6f}")
